Measured locally on the same nightly with ref-cycle collection off, 3 interleaved rounds: eff799b0 ran 5.84-5.99us and HEAD ede6d1c8 ran 7.12-7.18us (+22%). 3edea7d2 is the only commit in that range that touches the merge path. benchmark_id: js|moonbitlang/core/builtin|builtin/string_find_code_unit_bench_test.mbt|126|bench StringView find two anchors absent n=256|
block_label: bench StringView find two anchors absent n=256
note: Accepted tradeoff from moonbitlang/core#4522 (8020ee22), which sends forward find of 2-250 code units on JS to V8's indexOf. V8 searches patterns shorter than 7 code units by scanning for the first code unit and comparing the rest; here the haystack is all 'a' and the pattern starts with 'a', so every position is a candidate (~8ns each), where the old two-anchor search filtered on the last code unit as well. Reproduces locally: 529ns to 2.17us from 8020ee22^ to 8020ee22. Plain V8 shows the same cost: "a".repeat(256).indexOf("az") takes about 2.1us in Node 22. The PR measured this case and accepted it for its gains on realistic searches (split_once on headers 1.5-61x faster on V8, find adversary m=64 15x faster).
